prompt.project_info: Create a bright pastel-toned tropical lifestyle portrait showing a relaxed seaside getaway moment.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with soft rounded features, subtle smile, rosy cheeks, and long loose dark brown waves. She wears a wide-brim straw hat, a white plumeria flower near her right ear, a cream woven shoulder tote, a white off-shoulder corset-style top with front lacing, and a light-yellow tiered flowing skirt.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical mid-length framing from head to below knees, single subject centered slightly right, relaxed standing pose with torso angled slightly left and gaze toward camera. Balance her with vertical palm trunks and thatched huts. Show manicured green lawn, ocean shoreline, clear blue sky, and low visual clutter.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even natural daylight from overhead and slightly frontal, minimal harsh shadows, warm airy pastel yellow, white, palm green, sky blue, straw beige, and soft pink palette.
prompt.technical_specs: Eye-level standard-to-slight-wide portrait lens, moderate depth of field with the subject sharp and background identifiable, clean low-noise high-resolution travel photography, natural skin tones and gentle contrast, no typography.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A bright pastel-toned tropical lifestyle portrait featuring an adult woman with long loose dark brown waves, a subtle smile and rosy cheeks, wearing a wide-brim straw hat, a white plumeria flower near her right ear, a cream woven shoulder tote, a white off-shoulder corset-style top with front lacing, and a light-yellow tiered flowing skirt. Relaxed standing pose, torso angled slightly left, gaze on-camera, vertical portrait framing from head to below knees, subject centered slightly right. Set her on a resort lawn with tall palms, thatched-roof huts, ocean shoreline, and clear blue sky. Soft natural daylight, warm airy pastel palette, eye-level standard-to-slight-wide portrait lens, moderate depth of field, clean low-noise lifestyle travel photography, serene idyllic vacation mood.
